However, the reference prominently shows a task-editing modal occupying the upper area, while the generated page shows the timer dashboard, task list, and controls instead. Major structural differences reduce similarity.

The generated page lacks the reference’s modal input, note/project links, Save/Cancel controls, and instead adds timer tabs, a countdown, Start button, task card, Add Task area, and statistics.
- **Content and Text (40 points): 13/40** — The lower informational heading “An online Pomodoro Timer to boost your productivity” and “What is Pomofocus?” are similar. The reference contains task-editing text such as “What are you working on?”, “Est Pomodoros,” “Add Note,” “Add Project,” “Cancel,” and “Save,” while the generated page contains substantially different dashboard text including “25:00,” “START,” “Pomodoro,” and task “123.”
- **Style (15 points): 8/15** — The red color palette, white typography, rounded cards, and general Pomofocus visual language are consistent. Nevertheless, the generated page uses a different composition, spacing, card treatment, and control styling from the reference modal.
- **Overall (20 points): 6/20** — The pages appear to belong to the same application and share branding and some lower-page content, but they represent different UI states with substantial differences in layout, visible components, and text.

**Score: 36/100**
